defs.def: to give sb support, courage or hope 支持；鼓励；激励

ex.s: Instead, encourage them to do differently next time.
ex.t: 相反，鼓励他们下次换一种不同的做法。

ex.s: To encourage competition.
ex.t: 成长过程中，我一直向往独立。

ex.s: To improve the quality of observational data, biodiversity apps can also encourage users to have an expert confirm the identification of their uploaded image.”
ex.t: 为提高观测数据的质量，生物多样性应用也可以鼓励用户请专家确认他们上传图片的鉴定结果。”

ex.s: Inside the office, they encourage recycling and waste reduction by limiting garbage cans and avoiding single-use plastic.
ex.t: 在办公室里，他们通过减少垃圾桶、避免使用一次性塑料来鼓励回收利用和减少浪费。

ex.s: To encourage writing for the magazine.
ex.t: 鼓励为杂志写作。

ex.s: This unbeatable price-point encouraged me to experiment with dozens of titles that I would never normally consider buying.
ex.t: 这种无可比拟的价格优势鼓励我去尝试了几十种我平时绝不会考虑购买的书籍。

ex.s: He was encouraged by a close neighbour.
ex.t: 他受到了一位亲密邻居的鼓励。

ex.s: Despite her encouraging smile, I wanted to sink through the floor because I was unsure about its pronunciation as well as its meaning.
ex.t: 尽管她面带鼓励的微笑，我却恨不得找个地缝钻进去，因为我不确定它的发音，也不确定它的意思。

ex.s: If you’re willing to apply yourself, I think you have a good shot at this.” Encouraged by his words, I agreed to give it a try.
ex.t: 如果你愿意下功夫，我觉得你很有胜算。受到他这番话的鼓舞，我同意试一试。

ex.s: If you’re willing to apply yourself, I think you have a good shot at this.” Encouraged by his words, I agreed to give it a try.
ex.t: 如果你愿意下功夫，我觉得你很有胜算。受到他这番话的鼓舞，我同意试一试。

ex.s: To encourage her to take up a hobby.
ex.t: 为了鼓励她培养一个爱好。

ex.s: I encourage you to take his offer.
ex.t: 我鼓励你接受他的邀请。

ex.s: I’ve learned a few things along the way though, which I hope you’ll find encouraging if you’re doing your best to figure out how you can make the change in a not-always-supportive household.
ex.t: 不过，在这一过程中我学到了一些东西，如果你正努力在一个并非总是支持你的家庭里弄清楚如何做出改变，我希望这些能给你鼓励。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过欣然接受错误、明智地让自己处于可能犯错的位置，我们事实上能克服弱点、变得更强。

ex.s: Which of the following would the author encourage you to do?
ex.t: 以下哪项是作者会鼓励你去做的事情？

ex.s: Talking about food encouraged her parents to finally open up about their past, like the fact that her father had owned a Chinatown restaurant in the 1940s.
ex.t: 谈论食物促使她的父母终于敞开心扉谈起了他们的过去，比如她父亲在1940年代曾拥有一家唐人街餐馆。

ex.s: encourage the students to answer questions
ex.t: 鼓励学生们回答问题。

ex.s: I would have given it up if I had not heard my father's encouraging shouts to cheer me on.
ex.t: 要不是听到父亲那鼓励我、为我加油的喊声，我早就放弃了。

ex.s: Her efforts have encouraged others to take part by running through a global campaign called“Run Blue”.
ex.t: 她的努力鼓励其他人通过一个名为"Run Blue"的全球 campaign 参与进来。

ex.s: To encourage research in education.
ex.t: 为了鼓励教育领域的研究。

ex.s: It encourages face-to-face interactions.
ex.t: 它鼓励面对面的互动。

ex.s: Students are encouraged to take control of their own learning,                just depending on the teacher.
ex.t: 学生们被鼓励掌控自己的学习                不只是依赖老师。

ex.s: In addition to 31    skills, Pruitt's lessons teach teamwork, encourage self-worth, and promote feelings of community.
ex.t: 除了   31    技能之外普鲁特的课程还教授团队合作鼓励自我价值感并促进社区意识。

ex.s: I encourage readers to go to their local library when they can’t afford to purchase a book.
ex.t: 我鼓励读者在买不起书时，去当地的图书馆。

ex.s: Encourage readers to use the library.
ex.t: 鼓励读者使用图书馆。

ex.s: Emoji can help communication feel friendlier, and even a serious note can be softened with an encouraging smile.
ex.t: 表情符号能让沟通显得更友好，即使是严肃的留言，加上一个鼓励的微笑也能变得柔和。

ex.s: The best housewarming parties encourage old friends to get together.
ex.t: 最好的乔迁派对能让老朋友聚在一起。

ex.s: He was encouraged by Susan to show his genius for art.
ex.t: 苏珊鼓励他展示自己的艺术天赋。

ex.s: To encourage people to work in public libraries.
ex.t: 强调公共图书馆的重要性。

ex.s: Mr Mills's encouraging remark.
ex.t: 她咄咄逼人的性格。

ex.s: It encourages us to occupy our own little corner, to avoid foolish leaps into the dark, to be satisfied.
ex.t: 它鼓励我们待在自己那个小角落里，避免愚蠢地冒险，安于现状。

ex.s: To encourage the man.
ex.t: 为了鼓励这个男人。

ex.s: Encourage team work .
ex.t: 鼓励团队合作。

ex.s: To encourage the man.
ex.t: 为了鼓励这个男人。

ex.s: While the decline over the past decade is steep for teen readers, some data in the report shows that reading remains a big part of many children’s lives, and indicates how parents might help encourage more reading.
ex.t: 虽然过去十年青少年读者的下降幅度很大，但报告中的一些数据显示阅读仍然是许多儿童生活中的重要部分，并表明家长可能如何帮助鼓励更多阅读。

ex.s: How should parents encourage their children to read more?
ex.t: 家长应该如何鼓励孩子多读书？

ex.s: Another reason for corn’s rise: The government encourages farmers to grow corn instead of rice   64   (improve) water quality.
ex.t: 玉米崛起的另一个原因：政府鼓励农民种玉米而非水稻，____64____（改善）水质。

ex.s: To encourage studies on culture.
ex.t: 推广维多利亚时代的价值观。

ex.s: To encourage donations.
ex.t: 找到了一个铁丝篮子。

ex.s: These advertise the presence of chicks to adults; they might also encourage our chick to start calling as well.
ex.t: 这些（叫声）向成鸟宣告雏鸟的存在；它们也可能促使我们的雏鸟也开始鸣叫。

ex.s: To encourage people to study music.
ex.t: 爵士乐的兴衰。

ex.s: While high school does not generally encourage students to explore new aspects of life, college sets the stage for that exploration.
ex.t: 虽然高中通常不鼓励学生探索生活的新方面，但大学为这种探索搭建了舞台。

ex.s: Alistair says that they encourage each other as much as they can when they train.
ex.t: Alistair说他们在训练时尽可能地互相鼓励。

ex.s: The "rainbow in the clouds" philosophy has encouraged a lot of people.
ex.t: “云中彩虹”的理念鼓励了很多人。

ex.s: Mum encouraged me to try different kinds of food, and I did!
ex.t: 妈妈鼓励我尝试不同种类的食物，我照做了！

ex.s: This, however, was a time when women were not encouraged to become writers.
ex.t: 然而，在那个时代，女性并不被鼓励成为作家。

ex.s: It encourages people to be responsible travellers and involves educating them about the natural world.
ex.t: 它鼓励人们成为负责任的旅行者，并涉及对人们进行自然世界的教育。

ex.s: That dream reminded me that those fears and desires could encourage me to take risks and make experiments.
ex.t: 那个梦提醒我，那些恐惧和欲望可以鼓励我去冒险和尝试。

ex.s: My mother also encouraged me to make what I wanted.
ex.t: 母亲也鼓励我做自己想要的东西。

ex.s: One of his friends had stopped to make a bicycle repair, but they had encouraged Mac to carry on, and they would catch up with him soon.
ex.t: 他的一个朋友停下来修自行车，但他们鼓励麦克继续前进，说很快就会赶上他。

ex.s: According to a new study from market analysts, 1 in 5 Britons say that watching cookery programmes on TV has encouraged them to try different food.
ex.t: 根据市场分析师的一项新研究，五分之一的英国人表示，看电视上的烹饪节目鼓励他们尝试不同的食物。

ex.s: When your children are finished with their magazines encourage them to pass their issue on to a sibling or other family member.
ex.t: 当孩子们读完杂志，鼓励他们把那期传给兄弟姐妹或其他家人。

ex.s: I found the pre-holidays a good time to encourage young children to donate less-used things, and it worked.
ex.t: 我发现节前是鼓励小孩子捐赠不太用得上的东西的好时机，而且这招很管用。

defs.def: to persuade sb to do sth by making it easier for them and making them believe it is a good thing to do 鼓动；劝告；怂恿
to make sth more likely to happen or develop 促进；助长；刺激

ex.s: As far as your brain is concerned, there are processes that discourage exercise, and processes that encourage it.
ex.t: 就你的大脑而言，有些过程会阻碍锻炼，有些过程则会促进锻炼。

ex.s: It encourages abstract thinking.
ex.t: 它能促进抽象思维。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: They tolerate long, slow journeys to and from work on packed highways because they can work, entertain themselves or sleep on the ride, which encourages urban spread.
ex.t: 他们忍受在拥挤的高速公路上漫长而缓慢的上下班通勤，因为他们可以在途中工作、娱乐或睡觉，这促进了城市扩张。

ex.s: She was skeptical that the language requirement would encourage integration.
ex.t: 她对语言要求能否促进融合持怀疑态度。
